What I checked:
- **Scope of the diff.** The diff 3a1d8862..5c1d1692 changes only runtime_release_contract, collect_runtime_gate, export_freeze_runtime_kit and the tests, plus the retained 002100Z freeze and gate-refusal logs. Every other source hash above is identical.
- **How `has_failed_verdict` works.** It removes the exact negated quoted reference ("no later" followed by the quoted failure phrase, case-insensitive, in straight or curly quotes), and only when the comment's first line is exactly the PASS verdict phrase or "Source review: PASS". After that, it keeps the original broad substring refusal. With `include_source=True` it also refuses on a failed source-review substring.
- **Where it applies.** All four collector checks (PR, production source, proof source and kit) and the exporter's supersession check now use it.
- **Unchanged checks.** FAILURE_REFERENCE_POLICY is now a required token in both production_source_review and review_tokens, so any new kit audit must carry it. Every older check is unchanged.
- **My own probes of the classifier:**

  | Comment | Result |
  |---|---|
  | My 6115595393 wording | not a failure |
  | A bare failure verdict | refuses |
  | A PASS header plus an added real failure line | refuses |
  | A PASS header with a non-negated reference | refuses |
  | The negated reference under an unknown header | refuses |
  | A failed source review, with include_source | refuses |

  Removing the exact phrase can only lower the match count for a PASS-headed comment. Any other occurrence still refuses, so this is never weaker than the first-line rule.
- **Tests.** 164 tests ran from the extraction. 163 pass. The one exception is test_old_guard_and_verifier_bytes_stay_exact, which needs `git show HEAD:`, so I verified those hashes directly.

Scope: this PASS covers the packaging source only. It does not authorise a gate or any live action. A NEW unique kit may be frozen once, from the SAME stopped PASSED proof 234650Z (receipt 257196f530a0494ca0ba43023091febe670bc894c063d4bdd99e98f23d979c0d), with no proof or build replay. A NEW exact-kit audit carrying the policy token must follow before any gate. Production stays on 171dd36c/bac52, and all forward-only and no-touch rules are unchanged.
